composition_subtypes.role: Enumerate all subarrays (l, r) via nested loops.
Sort inside ascending and outside descending to pick swap candidates.

payload.core_composition_summary: Exhaustive subarray search combined with greedy sorting-based element swaps to maximize subarray sum after at most k swaps.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates all O(n^2) subarrays (complete search) and for each sorts elements to determine beneficial swaps, using both mechanisms in coordination.
